research.title: Robust Intent Classification Under Conversational Noise
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare intent classifiers under spelling errors, abbreviated phrasing, and missing punctuation using controlled text perturbations.
Evaluated linear and transformer classifiers on matched data splits, examining macro F1, prediction confidence, and confusion patterns across noise conditions.

publications.title: Evaluating Intent Classifier Robustness to Spelling Errors and Informal Conversational Text

work.title: Document Processing Service Maintenance
bullets: Maintained Python components for document ingestion, input validation, and metadata extraction within an existing processing service.
Investigated parsing failures, added regression tests for malformed inputs, and updated error handling to support routine operational troubleshooting.

projects.title: Lexical and Dense Retrieval for Question Matching
bullets: Implemented TF-IDF and pretrained sentence embedding baselines for matching user questions to relevant entries in a question archive.
Compared retrieval rankings using reciprocal rank and recall, inspecting failures involving paraphrases, rare terminology, and overlapping question topics.

projects.title: Comparative Sequence Labeling for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented recurrent and transformer sequence labeling baselines using a shared tokenization alignment procedure and consistent training and evaluation splits.
Compared entity span precision and recall, analyzing boundary errors and performance differences between frequent and infrequent entity types.
